description: Machine-readable feature-parity registry (PyQt6 = canonical model; Tauri/React web app must match). Statuses: parity | gap (requires open issue) | exempt (requires reason). Entries with pending_decision=true await the desktop-only exemption decision in issue #7460 (G12). See docs/development/feature_parity_matrix.md (generated) and epic #7462.

launcher.tile_grid.title: Launcher tile grid from shared manifest
launcher.tile_grid.notes: Both shells render tiles from src/config/launcher_manifest.json via the shared loader.

simulation.realtime_ws_stream.title: Live simulation data over WebSocket pub-sub

platform.aip_protocol.title: AI Protocol (AIP) structured method dispatch
platform.aip_protocol.notes: API-backed protocol; both shells are thin consumers.

tools.terrain_engine.title: Terrain and topography configuration
tools.terrain_engine.notes: Web-first tool; the desktop launcher opens the web route.

tools.dataset_generator.title: Swing dataset generation and import
tools.dataset_generator.notes: Web-first tool; the desktop launcher opens the web route.

analysis.static_plots.title: Static analysis plots (20+ plot types)
analysis.static_plots.notes: Reached parity via #7449 (closed completed 2026-06-12). GET /analysis/plot-types enumerates AnalysisOrchestrator.PLOT_TYPES; GET /analysis/plot-data/{plot_type} returns PlotData JSON rendered by the web PlotsSection.

simulation.controls_wiring.title: Web SimulationControls wiring (camera presets, recording toggle, trajectory export, force overlays, actuator controls)

chat.live_context.title: Live app/engine context in chat
chat.live_context.notes: Shared ChatAppContext schema (#7453): both server wirings install make_app_state_provider; web chip via GET /chat/context.

simulation.shot_tracer.title: Shot Tracer / ball-flight visualization
simulation.shot_tracer.notes: Reached parity via #7456 (closed completed 2026-06-12); web BallFlight page consumes the existing /ball_flight API.

settings.preferences.title: Settings/preferences surface + persistence
settings.preferences.notes: Web /settings route (appearance/notifications/simulation-defaults/diagnostics) persisted server-side to ~/.upstreamdrift/web_settings.json; theme round-trips via the shared /themes router (#7457).

settings.desktop_only_tabs.title: Desktop-only settings tabs (MCP Servers, Processes, Startup/Docker, Layout, Performance)
settings.desktop_only_tabs.reason: Desktop-process management (MCP server processes, Docker startup, window layout, app zoom of native widgets) has no browser equivalent; awaiting the desktop-only exemption decision in issue #7460.

diagnostics.integrations_health.title: Diagnostics + integrations-health panel
diagnostics.integrations_health.notes: Single probe implementation (DIAGNOSTIC_CHECKS in launcher_diagnostics.py + integrations_health_data.py) feeds the desktop panels and GET /api/v1/diagnostics/full + /api/v1/integrations/health (issue #7458).
